Off-peak update for an upbeat period
Please take a moment
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers with companion animals should review their travel details with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure. Our team is updating routine records and care plans so each animal can be handled with steady attention and clear support.

We record service changes in the desk ledger so the most current arrangements are easy to follow across the journey. Care plans are adjusted with close regard for species, temperament, and comfort, and our staff works carefully to keep each traveler informed in plain language. This helps us support pets that settle quickly, pets that need a quieter setting, and pets that benefit from extra reassurance during processing.

If your plans have changed, please let the desk know as soon as possible so we can align the notes with the travel file. Small updates can affect kennel placement, handoff steps, and the level of care prepared for the trip, so prompt communication is always helpful. We appreciate your cooperation and the calm it brings to the work of the operation.

Please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for assistance before you travel.
